content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Bremerton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and specific project management education hours—but no prior work experience. This makes CAPM ideal for career changers and early-career professionals entering Bremerton's defense, healthcare, and government sectors seeking structured credentials.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format condenses the required contact hours into an accelerated schedule, letting you earn your eligibility while balancing work and personal commitments from anywhere.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, file your official PMI application and pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy guides you through every step to ensure your submission is accurate and complete.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review core project-management knowledge and practice questions. You'll sit for the computer-based CAPM exam at a Pearson VUE testing center, on your schedule.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. During that cycle, earn professional development units by attending training, conferences, or completing project-management activities. Renewal keeps your credential current and demonstrates ongoing professional commitment.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

Even where certification isn't mandatory, it strengthens your candidacy and signals competency to organizations managing complex, regulated shipyard and defense projects.
